text: VMLM 是一个把 Transformer 权重预先汇编成指令流的推理引擎。 The engine is no_std and links against kernel32 directly.

results.name: stage A: Rust encoder produced ids
stage A: Rust ids == Python ids (independent encoders)
stage B1: identity model passes the ids through unchanged
stage B2: ids -> placeholder logits -> argmax -> ids runs
stage B2: generated ids decode without a guard firing
stage B2: generated text == input text
results.detail: the logits are a seeded placeholder, not a model, so the decoded text is NOT expected to match. Reported rather than asserted -- this task owns the tokenizer, not the model.

results.name: stage C: Rust round trip is byte-identical
stage D: Python decoder agrees byte for byte
control: mutating ONE token id changes the Rust output
control: the mutated output is not merely a re-encode
results.detail: also differs from the Python decoder's output
